title: Epic Systems (MyChart)

themes.theme: Epic AI & Value-Based Care Paradigm Shift
Epic Prior Auth & Ambient Listening Opportunities

positions.commentary: Constellation Software is a roll-up with some of its biggest companies being vertical market healthcare and healthcare IT.

thesis: This episode argues that Epic Systems is a dominant incumbent with a strong bull case driven by its expansion into new specialties (billing, pharma, payers), its position as the industry choke point for software innovation, and regulatory entrenchment. However, it also highlights bearish risks including potential antitrust violations under the Sherman Act, lower willingness to pay internationally, and the threat of AI or value-based care paradigm shifts that could change health system needs.

claims.quote: So they're expanding to a whole new set of potential customers who could pay them because of their dominant position. I think that's extremely credible. They could have an even larger business.

claims.claim: Regulation is a bull case for Epic as an incumbent that can entrench itself.
claims.quote: Ben: I think that’s fair, and that’s on top of everything we’ve already talked about. No one is switching off of them. Revenue from their install base will just continue to grow. This is what happens once you become an incumbent.
